props.caption: Kramatorsk, in Donetsk's fortress belt, where a glide bomb hit two passenger buses on Thursday.

props.title: Hurricane Isaias
props.caption: The center was near 25.4 North, 88.4 West at 10 p.m. CDT. A Tropical Cyclone Update puts Isaias at 120 mph; Intermediate Advisory 11A listed 110.
Oil is still flowing through the Strait of Hormuz, Trump said, while the port blockade stays.

items.note: Two passenger buses burned on a Kramatorsk street. Moscow has not named a military target.
A Tropical Cyclone Update put Isaias at 120 mph. Intermediate Advisory 11A listed 110 mph.
Trump said no U.S. strike on Iran before 3 November. The port blockade remains; oil still flows at Hormuz.
An ICE officer fired near West 225th Street on Thursday. DHS has not said why the officer shot.
Britain added twelve shadow-fleet tankers. Whether those hulls are still loading Russian oil is unpublished.

lead.what: U.S. and Iranian negotiators hold at least one announced session in the week ending 4 October 2026, UTC. Checked today's 37-story corpus including s-3a77d1ca and s-afa3fba4; AP on 8 Oct says talks have been at a standstill since late September and records no announced U.S.–Iran session in the week ending 4 Oct UTC.

lead.what: A Russian glide bomb hit two passenger buses in Kramatorsk. Rescue officials put the dead at 33, regional officials at 30.

rest.what: A Tropical Cyclone Update puts Isaias at 120 mph; Intermediate Advisory 11A listed 110. There is a 70% probability that the National Hurricane Center posts an advisory of at least 111 mph by 12:00 UTC on 10 October.

rest.kicker: ICE Shoots Man In New York
rest.what: An ICE officer fired in a Thursday Marble Hill arrest. The mayor said talks with Trump failed; Friday morning the man remained in federal custody.
